seo.title: Zendesk AI agent for WhatsApp and chat support | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Zendesk to Steps AI. Your agent answers common questions and turns the ones it cannot solve into tickets for your support team.

hero.title: Answer the common questions. Send the rest to Zendesk.
hero.body: Your agent handles everyday support on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website. When something needs a person, it creates a ticket with the details your team needs.
hero.reassurance: Tickets where your team works. The fields you require. Clear handover to a person.

lines.text: My blender stopped working after a week.
Sorry to hear that. I have opened a support ticket and our team will reply within a day.

useCases.title: What you can do with Zendesk connected.
useCases.intro: Let the agent take the repeat questions, and keep your team on the ones that need judgement.

items.title: Turn problems into tickets
items.body: When the agent cannot solve something, it creates a ticket with the subject, reason and conversation details.

items.title: Ask for the right details first
items.body: Set required fields such as order number, photo or phone number, so tickets arrive ready to work on.

items.title: Decide when to raise a ticket
items.body: Describe in plain English when the ticket skill should be used, with examples of when it should not.

items.title: Notify the right people
items.body: Choose who gets an email when a new ticket is created.

walkthrough.title: From a complaint to a ticket your team can act on.

steps.label: Understand the problem
steps.customer: My blender stopped working after a week.
steps.agent: Sorry about that. Could you share your order number?
steps.note: The agent collects the fields you marked as required.

steps.label: Ask for evidence
steps.agent: Thanks. Could you send a short photo or video of the issue?
steps.note: Media fields are supported for tickets.

steps.label: Create the ticket
steps.agent: I have opened a ticket for your team. You will hear back within a day.
steps.note: A Zendesk ticket is created and the people you chose are notified.

setup.title: Connect Zendesk in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Zendesk
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Zendesk. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Zendesk to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Add the ticket skill
items.body: Switch on ticket creation for your agent, choose Zendesk, and set the fields and people to notify.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Tickets can also be kept in the built-in Steps AI CRM if you do not use Zendesk.
Write a clear rule for when to raise a ticket, so the agent does not open one for questions it can answer.

items.q: Will every conversation become a ticket?
items.a: No. Tickets are created only when the conditions you describe are met.

items.q: Can I add my own fields?
items.a: Yes. Add custom fields such as text, number, email, phone, dropdown or media, and mark them as required.

items.q: Can a person take over the chat instead?
items.a: Yes. Human handoff is a separate skill with a wait time, a fallback message and email alerts.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Zendesk.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Zendesk and your own information.
